text: Attempt 8 begins: replay attempt 6's build order (the best city, ~4,400 people per loan) with the guarded tools; the loan guard now also refuses under 3,000 people per loan from 30,000 people; taxes steady at 8-9% from 30,000.

Attempt 8 started. Attempt 7 borrowed more for fewer people and went broke in 2046 (peak 91,980). This one replays attempt 6, the best city so far (120,770), with tighter loan limits and steadier taxes.
